commits_info.message:
3.3.4 release (previous 3.3.3) + release notes updated by CI build 4397

[ci skip-release]

Fixes #1875 : Fix mocks throwing same instance with throwable class (#1890)

Fixes mocks throwing the same instance consecutively of a given
throwable class after specifying the mock behaviour with doThrow(Class)
or thenThrow(Class).

issues.title: thenThrow(Class) no longer creates new instances
